items.text: Patch 2.00.05 is out now. A lot of what's in here comes straight from what you've been telling us on here and on Discord.
Across the game: faster sprint dribbling, higher acceleration, smoother traps, and a bunch of crash fixes, including some PS5-specific ones.
In 5v5: throw-ins and corners are now seamless kick-ins with no teleports or cutscenes, the Mercy Rule is in Ranked, and the offside line now shows on the radar.
Full patch notes below 👇 Give it a go and let us know what you think
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920323/b4f0e368be208b6c29575824f12345a75d5754f6.png"]
RS Switching: Improved nearby player selection.
Dribbling: Faster sprint dribbling, shorter touches and more responsive close control.
Movement: Increased player acceleration.
Passing: Long through passes are slightly more manual and less accurate.
Trapping: Replaced side-step traps with acceleration boosts based on stats and exit direction.
Fixed several issues with sprint touches, passing and trapping.
Mercy Rule: Added to Ranked.
Kick-Ins: Replaced throw-ins and corners with seamless kick-ins, removing teleports and cutscenes. Passes can be pre-charged.
Offside Line: Added to the radar.
Cross Defense: Disabled automatic goalkeeper punches on crosses.
Fixed goalkeepers rushing out prematurely.
Improved sprint acceleration animations and transitions.
Improved idle turns and AI recovery behavior.
Fixed several crashes, including PS5 memory and character data issues.
Improved rendering performance based on camera distance.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920323/2b741f88389e3a9f2d7494bdd8d9b396018419bb.png"]
Addition of the new semi-manual passing system.
Improved ground, through, cross and lofted passes.
Refined pass trajectories.
Improved Through Pass receiver behaviour, first-touch alignment and trap timing.
Improved trapping based on relative player speed, with faster recovery for high-quality traps.
Fixed several issues causing unreliable traps, excessive backpedaling and incorrect receiver movement.
Fixed an issue where the ball could speed up after bouncing.
Fixed unnatural vertical ball movement caused by incorrect damping.
Flick passes now require L2, reducing accidental activation.
Improved touch rotation and turning behaviour.
Players can now move toward their intended exit direction while executing a touch, improving responsiveness.
Further tuning to Close Dribbling, reducing excessive or unwanted spinning while changing direction.
Removed cases where touches could incorrectly cancel trap cooldowns.
Reverted the previous Tackle Back logic and increased its radius from 30 cm to 70 cm.
AI auto-tackle range now matches human-controlled players.
Reintroduced shorter stumbles from passive barges during skill moves, removing the ”shield” effect.
Improved blocking radiuses across different height zones, nerfing goal line blocks.
Fixed defenders incorrectly prioritizing Auto Shield on ground balls.
Improved possession-state logic during passes and clearances.
Reduced stamina drain by approximately 10% in 5v5.
Increased stamina recovery by approximately 10% in 5v5.
Improved bot passing decisions and adaptation to the new passing system.
Improved Through Pass positioning and usage, including difficulty-based behaviour.
Midfielders now mark more consistently and track back with greater urgency.
Defending AI is less likely to unintentionally take possession.
Improved attacking bot obstacle avoidance.
Restored intended bot difficulty settings.
Added additional scenario-specific AI behaviours and optimizations.
Improved goalkeeper decision-making between Auto Tackle and Auto Clearance.
Reduced disruptive player collisions immediately after saves.
Fixed animation issues affecting some goalkeeper saves.
Improved matchmaking for players on high-ping connections, helping provide more reliable match quality.
Achievements are now active on both Steam and the Epic Games Store.
Added a new AMP pitch.
Improved character lighting and visibility.
Improved exposure and gamma to better resemble a TV football broadcast.
Fixed cases where goal nets could fail to appear.
Fixed false VRAM overheating warnings on AMD RDNA3/RDNA4 GPUs.
Added various AI, scenario and performance fixes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920323/c2cddfda504db0fdc77b085a024fbf97a3755f89.png"]
Improved sprinting and locomotion, with new sprint animations, faster acceleration from low speeds, and updated movement blending.
Reduced excessive spinning with adjustments to turn acceleration.
Adjusted standing tackle lunge distances.
Improved ghost tackle readability with a new reach animation when attempting a tackle that doesn’t connect.
Adjusted assisted blocking, including reaction times on shots and blocking radius based on ball height.
Fixed a rare issue where first-time shots could fail to trigger.
Re-enabled Basic (L1) Switching settings, including Closest to Ball and Closest to Ball Goal-Side.
Bots can now fill empty slots in 5v5 Quickplay.
Updated stamina balancing for 5v5.
Added an option to always display player names in 5v5.
Updated AMP visuals with improved post-processing, color grading, and character lighting.
Updated Aerotech grass from black to teal.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920323/381099d1d81e4b12a5faa1b2341b31e10f4fe745.png"]
This update includes the 5v5 game mode! However, it won't be visible in-game right away as we'll be activating it server-side. We’ll drop an announcement as soon as it goes live. Stay tuned!
5v5 mode is now live!
Implemented the 5v5 Game Mode
5v5 Quickplay is now available for everyone. Quickly jump into a 5v5 match against other users or squads
5v5 Lobby Mode is now available for everyone. You can create custom lobbies and share the code with your friends or the rest of the community.
Social Menu: Available now in the Main Menu.
Create or join a squad with your friends or other community members.
The Squad leader will be able to either join a Custom Lobby or initiate the quickplay matchmaking to compete against other teams.
Introduced 36 new Challenges in the Featured tab exclusive for the 5v5 game mode.
Disabled automatic bot fill-ups and turned off the "Any" player mode option by default.
Reordered and updated the quickchat radial with more useful tactical and team-only options.
Added a post-pause countdown timer and extended the pre-pause grace period to give players more preparation time.
Fixed an issue where non-party leaders would incorrectly see the "Play Again" button on the end-of-match screen.
Centered player names on the top HUD bar and fixed permanent bot name displays.
Updated lobby and quickplay game mode selection art.
Lowered the sprint dribbling max speed penalty.
Increased the contextual sprint dribbling touch cadence.
Decreased the turn penalty on manual defending.
Increased Goalkeeper reaction time.
Less speed loss on turns while sprint dribbling.
Reduced the physical shoulder barge radius and halved the guaranteed physical tackle range to make defending more skill-based and rewarding.
Added a toggleable setting to preview an early version of real-time visual feedback for pass targeting during matches.
Reduced the radius for AI auto-tackles and fixed goalkeepers incorrectly triggering auto-tackles outside the penalty box.
Improved offensive AI positioning and run-tracking calculations to reduce crowding and clutter in the attacking third.
Fixed a server packet corruption bug that occurred when handling very high volume of cards that could cause connection errors with the server.
Updated in-game text localization files across multiple languages.

items.text: Next week, we have a very special activation involving Adidas and some well-known faces in football gaming! Stay tuned for the 11th, as it will feature several in-game challenges and FREE exclusive kits that will last for a month! More details on the 11th of August!

Reworked close dribbling touch cadence logic based on the angle of the previous touch, increasing responsiveness on directional changes after straight touches, while limiting how quickly consecutive touches at an angle can be taken based on the close dribbling stat.
Improved overall skill move input responsiveness and polished visual phantom touch control helpers.
Adjusted auto-tackle mechanics so player speed no longer restricts your tackle reach or recovery time.
Lowered the effect of shoulder barges and physical tackles on players dribbling at high speed, while increasing the effect on players dribbling at low speed
Improved accuracy of collision checks for some saves.
Reduced goalkeepers' effectiveness against chip shots.
Increased power shot accuracy and reduced shot dispersion from medium-to-long range (16–30 meters).
Added new tactical formations (including 4-3-3 Build-Up and 4-2-3-1 Wide) along with a new Center Forward (CF) position option.
Added custom attacking positioning settings directly inside tactical game plans.
Expanded custom game plans to fully support specialized player mentalities and roles.
Improved defensive line positioning stability and tracking of off-the-ball attacker runs.
Fixed an issue where movement lock-ons would fail to reset properly after physical tackles.
Fixed a visual issue where goalkeepers' wrists would bend or warp unnaturally during catch animations.
Polished several tactical formation menus to correct sorting orders and updated squad diagrams.
Added a warning alert to protect player menus and prevent display issues when holding a very high number of player card fragments.
Updated and polished several game localization files across multiple languages.
Improved network packet delivery and connection stability by optimizing automatic MTU discovery.
Fixed a startup crash affecting players running the game on Windows ARM emulation setups.
Optimized background AI pathfinding and playbook logic to resolve minor in-match performance stutters.
New Fixed Challenges: Added Rookie, Contender, and Champion challenges to offer better progression milestones and high-tier rewards.
New & Boosted Repeatables: Additional objectives, massively increased XP payouts (2x–5x) and improved pack rewards for Daily and Weekly challenges.
Tournament Updates: Since the 20th of July there are 2 new Tournaments: New Champions Cup and New Masters Cup featuring Potential Packs rewards that will be refreshed every Monday.
Improved player lock-on behavior during lofted through passes, reducing slowdowns in certain situations.
Fixed an issue where ball roll chaining and player unlocks could occur after idle skill moves.
Fixed an issue where Physical Tackle animations could fail to play even when the tackle conditions were met.
Reduced the frequency of shots hitting the post.
Fixed an issue that could cause Tournament brackets to break after facing the same opponent multiple times.
Fixed rare cases where incorrect platform icons could be displayed.
Fixed an issue that could, in some cases, leave players stuck on an empty pitch while connecting to a match.
Fixed a rare issue that could cause celebrations to become stuck.
General performance and stability improvements.

Movement: Improved movement responsiveness, including sprint execution and overall fluidity.: Improved ability of players to change movement direction directly after a pass.: Refined pass recoveries and movement transitions.

Passing & Trapping: Improved ground pass targeting with better passing lane detection and player selection.: Increased pass speeds and improved first-touch behavior, especially on slower passes.: Reduced lofted pass dispersion and refined through passes.: Improved trap execution and fixed several first-touch and trapping issues.

Shooting & Goalkeepers: Reduced shot dispersion and the frequency of shots hitting the post.: Improved low-powered shot animations.: Nerfed goalkeeper rushing to make aggressive rush-outs less effective, while rebalancing positioning and reactions.: Fixed rare goalkeeper animation issues.

Physicality & AI: Increased resistance to physical challenges while on the ball.: Standing tackles now scale more consistently with player attributes.: Tackles from behind are no longer allowed.: Disabled AI-initiated passive barges, reducing "auto defending" and placing more emphasis on manual defending.: Reduced AI overtracking, resulting in more natural defensive positioning and support.: Improved offensive and defensive positioning, run tracking, and support.
Shortened match introductions to get you into gameplay faster.
Added crowd reactions to fouls, yellow cards, and red cards.
Improved free kick audio.
Improved second player press indicator.
Added buzzer beater visuals to the radar.
Improved HUD animations, card event transitions, and menu polish.
Improved character requirement displays.
Fixed various UI alignment and navigation issues.
Improved Steam login, reconnect handling, and overall online stability.
Improved movement cache reliability and backend systems.
Fixed several crashes and platform-specific issues, including on PS5.
Fixed incorrect possession statistics.
Fixed tournament progression and substitute spawning issues.
Fixed multiple gameplay, passing, trapping, movement, and animation issues.
Various stability, performance, and telemetry improvements.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920323/3ea00de718d012e395c55f3015691de004336e74.png"]
Movement: Improved responsiveness with smoother acceleration, turning, and more impactful Agility.
Shooting: Reduced post hits, rebalanced lower-rated finishing, and added more shot variety.
Trapping: Improved trap timing, pre-trap movement, and receiving positioning.
Passing: Improved ground pass targeting for more reliable and consistent passing.
Goalkeepers: Fixed a case where goalkeepers could unrealistically speed up during forward dives.
Passing: Fixed an issue where invalid pass targets could cause passes back to the goalkeeper to fail.
Added a visual indicator for the second player press target.
Reworked net sound effects with new audio content and implementation.

Passing & Shooting: Major improvements to through-ball accuracy, including better turn prediction, smarter offside-line awareness, more reliable blocked-lane detection, and improved lofted through-pass consistency. Fixed an issue that could occasionally cause passes and shots to feel delayed.
Physicality & Defending: Stronger shoulder challenges, more impactful contact, increased jockey speed and responsiveness, and reduced reliance on Strength/Balance ratings at the low end.

Second Player Press: Pressers will now mirror dribblers more actively when closing down. The duration of this behavior scales with the Aggression attribute (0.5–2.0 seconds), after which their ability to mirror is significantly reduced, rewarding manual player switching and defending.
Skill Moves & Agility: Rebalanced skill move exit speeds to reduce unrealistic acceleration. Agility now has a stronger speed-versus-turning tradeoff, with improved turn responsiveness.
Goalkeeping: Added new save variations, improved save animations and positioning, and increased goalkeeper willingness to dive. Fixed issues with late duel unlocks and goalie strafe detection.

Defensive AI: Improved defensive line structures, with full-backs and wing-backs maintaining the offside line more effectively. Refined run-tracking and man-marking hand-off logic, and increased the flexibility of the marking system to reduce situations where defenders fail to react to dangerous attacking threats.
Collection: Added sorting options for Overall Rating and Potential. Favorite players can no longer be accidentally sold or discarded.

Tournaments: Tournaments now use a fully round-based format instead of SBMM matchmaking. This change will take effect when the current tournaments expire on Thursday. Tournament resets will also move to Mondays.
Ping priority: Continued tuning to improve the balance between queue times and server quality. Server ping is now prioritized more heavily when finding matches.
Improved cross targeting for more consistent and accurate deliveries into the box.
Increased dribbling responsiveness to give players more direct control on the ball.
Reduced pass delay, making passing feel quicker and more immediate.
Improved player switching (L1) responsiveness and target selection.
Reduced goalkeeper effectiveness when rushing out.
Improved sprint dribbling for lower-rated players.
Improved short through pass targeting and execution.
Improved defensive AI positioning and reactions against long ground through passes.
Increased speed retention for players making triggered runs.
Improved first-touch control and ball handling.
Reduced jockey movement effectiveness.
Reduced effectiveness of lobbed through passes.
Reduced effectiveness of second-man press.
Offensive AI improvements, including smarter runs, better spacing, more movement off the ball, and improved support positioning to create clearer passing and attacking opportunities.
Improved dribble turn animations.
Updated lobby ready-up animations.
Reorganized Challenges to better separate Daily, Weekly, and Global Cup objectives.
Fixed incorrect pricing displays in the Steam Premium Store for certain currencies.
Fixed kit previews not resetting correctly in Club Customization when using a controller.
Fixed menu freezes that could occur when resuming a console from sleep mode during Knockout tournaments.
Multiple stability and performance improvements.
Fixed a startup issue that could prevent some Steam and lower-end PC players from launching the game.
Fixed a menu freeze when opening the in-game store with the Steam Overlay disabled.
Fixed Steam invites not working correctly when the Steam Overlay was disabled.
Improved automatic graphics settings detection for lower-spec PCs.
Fixed pitch-side advertising boards occasionally appearing blank during matches.
Fixed an issue where stale lobby tickets could interfere with matchmaking searches.
Multiple crash and bug fixes
Fixed intermittent issues with missing Steam store offers.
Improved ground pass and through pass targeting to make pass aiming feel more natural and create smoother, more fluid passing play.
Lowered the maximum acceleration boost from stepovers.
Fixed an issue that could cause centre backs to position themselves too close to the goalkeeper.
Fixed set piece behaviors not resetting correctly after substitutions.
Iterated on defender line speeds.
Adjusted defender behavior in heel-to-heel scenarios.
Reduced stand tackle lunge distance at the high end.
Fixed free kick passes not executing correctly when holding the pass button.
Fixed shot execution failures after rebounds off the post.
Free kick animation polish.
Corner kick animation polish.
Aesthetic updates to lobby animations.
Aesthetic tweaks to low-powered forward ground passes.
Tweaks to dribble turn animations.
Updated low-power shot animations and tuned shot selection.
Fixed Knockout rewards becoming inaccessible when a tournament ended immediately after a match.

This release touches everything from how it feels to dribble in a tight space to how the game performs on your hardware. Jump in, push the limits, and tell us where it breaks. This is how we build the best football experience out there together.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920323/95443b63e0fb95e2dbc0d1a43b6734b3f85b2dfc.png"]

We’ve dropped a big one.

New tournaments to grind. New formations to master. New celebrations to flex after you bury the ball. Gameplay’s been tuned across the board; smarter standing tackles, cleaner ground passes, tighter turns, and deeper through balls that reward timing and vision. Training drills now hit with more variety so you can level up faster.
Jump in, push the limits, and tell us where it breaks.
This is how we build the best football experience out there together.
